description: Source code for training CIFAR10 with differential privacy using PyTorch and Torchvision, including data loading, model setup, training, evaluation, and checkpointing.

methods.name: save_checkpoint
methods.description: Saves training state to a file and updates the best model checkpoint if applicable.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Calculates the mean accuracy given predictions and labels.

methods.name: compute_norms
methods.description: Computes the L2 norms of per-sample gradients.

methods.name: clip_and_accumulate_and_add_noise
methods.description: Clips per-sample gradients, adds Gaussian noise, and updates model parameters.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Performs training for one epoch, including per-sample gradient computation, clipping, noise addition, and optimizer step.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates the model on the test dataset and reports accuracy.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set up data, model, optimizer, and run training and testing loops.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for training configuration.
